rows.text: What do you think, [Trailblazer]? The Simulated Universe is pretty fun, no?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: An idea hit me while you were exploring, so I immediately went for it. I decided to share my insights about the Simulated Universe with my sidekick here while I waited for you.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: We made a bet about Rubert the emperor. Historically, Rubert was destroyed and the Machine Empire collapsed. Some purport that Rubert was killed by an IPC assassin, and some claim that it was smashed up by the Lord of Silence.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Which version is the truth? I believe it was Polka Kakamond who did it.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: What are the stakes for the bet?
I think the first version has a possibility to be true. The IPC would fight Rubert I to the death.
rows.speaker: Little Robot

rows.text: We'll see. If I win, the sidekick will come clean with the Strategic Investment Department's purpose behind this trip — even though I'm not really interested.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Otherwise, I'll transfer the ownership of the Simulated Universe to the IPC.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: There's no way I'll lose by choosing the Lord of Silence! By the way, please don't tell Ruan Mei and Screwllum about this bet.
rows.speaker: Herta
